_comment: Map user-known card names to their canonical Scryfall name. Use this when a card has a non-Scryfall printed name (e.g., Universes Beyond / Final Fantasy variants that share oracle text with an existing card) and Scryfall's fuzzy lookup substitutes incorrectly. When resolving a card name, check this map first; if a match is found, look up the canonical name instead. Keys are case-sensitive as the user types them; values are the exact Scryfall name.
